is_anopheles.evidence: Study evaluated Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected in Homa Bay County, western Kenya (Page 1, Abstract; Page 3, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped Vgsc L1014S (kdr-east / Vgsc L995S), L1014F (kdr-west / Vgsc L995F), and Ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S) (Page 4, Methods; Page 6, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 6) reports allele frequencies for Vgsc L1014, L1014S, L1014F and Ace-1 G119S along with the number of mosquitoes genotyped (N) per zone and year (317 total for Vgsc and 263 total for Ace-1).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from irrigated and non-irrigated field sites in Homa Bay County, western Kenya between February and July in 2018 and 2019 and reared to adults (Page 3, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical field study reporting original bioassay and molecular genotype data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Sampling took place in irrigated and non-irrigated village clusters in Homa Bay County, western Kenya (Kimira-Oluch Smallholder Farm Improvement Project area, Fig 1, Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected between February and July in 2018 and 2019 (Page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper reports original field collections conducted by ICEMR in 2018-2019.

supplement.evidence: All primary genotype allele frequencies and sample sizes are reported in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site resistance mechanisms (Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, and Ace-1 G119S) in field-collected Anopheles arabiensis from irrigated and non-irrigated areas of Homa Bay County, western Kenya in 2018 and 2019. Low frequencies of both kdr-east (1-16%) and kdr-west (3-7%) were observed, while Ace-1 G119S was rare (0.7% in 2019 non-irrigated area only).
